qualification:
Unit-return adapter writing the actual Result into an initialized error slot.
Retains real Ref/Error types; overwriting the required initial error drops no guard.
Candidates until every contract and composed bridge check passes. This avoids
Kani's unsupported Arbitrary generation for foreign returned guard types;
no SDK source change, alternate guard or simplified result carrier is used.

expected_time: Cached optimized compilation then one actual SDK unit-output contract or its verified real-guard bridge on the existing10MiB/all signed-counter/all nonzero Rc domain.
remaining: Every actual contract/frame/bridge/safety check and cover must pass. Then complete native caller composition and full heap/runtime/ABI/child/oracle/TX2/S1/S6 binding. Generation is not proof.
